name: To Do
description: Today's tasks with repeats, streaks and a calm progress bar. Drag tasks into your own order; right-click one to color it, mark it important, number your plan or move it to tomorrow. Keys: N add, arrows select, Space done, F2 or E rename, Alt+arrows move, I, O, T, Del. Everything stays on your PC.
author: AmineChr54
changelog: Drag tasks to reorder them, color a task from its right-click menu, and renaming works on the first try (double-click, F2 or Edit).

dayStart.label: New day starts at (hour)
dayStart.hint: Night owl? Set 4 and tasks done at 1 am still count for the day before.

clearCompleted.label: Clear finished one-off tasks the next day
